 Summary
 Wales host Portugal at Cardiff City Stadium in group A4 of the Nations League
 Watch/listen live via buttons on this page
 Wales will finish bottom of their group but face a play-off in March to preserve their League A status
 A draw or a victory for Portugal - who have secured a spot in the quarter-finals - will ensure Jorge Jesus' men win the group
 Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes puts away side ahead with stunning strike on 11 minutes
 David Brooks delivers instant response for Wales to make it 1-1 before Sorba Thomas puts home side ahead 
 Pedro Neto volley brings Portugal level before half time
 Substitute Carlos Forbs drills away side ahead in 70th minute as goal scorer Neto red carded
